title: Kids Python
text: Kids Python: Courses home. Here you find chapters about variables, loops and functions.

title: Variables
text: A variable is a name that refers to a value. You create a variable with the assignment operator: name = value. Variables store strings and numbers for later use.

title: Variables
text: Variable names can contain letters, numbers and the underscore. A variable name cannot start with a number.

title: For loops
text: A for loop repeats a block of code once for every element. Use for i in range(5) to repeat five times. Loops can walk a list item by item.

title: For loops
text: The range(5) call gives the numbers 0, 1, 2, 3, 4. The stop value itself is not included.

title: Functions
text: A function is a named group of statements. Define one with the def keyword, then call it by its name. Functions let you write code once and reuse it.
